item.title: Lesson 138: “Heaven is the decision I must make.”
item.description: “Heaven is the decision I must make.” In this world Heaven is a choice, because here we believe there are alternatives to choose between. We think that all things have an opposite, and what we want we choose. If Heaven exists there must be hell as well, for contradiction is the way we make what we perceive and what we think is real.
